about: Numbers that exist only in validation/ files, copied here unchanged so the page can read them at runtime. Each entry names its source file and field path (or results_final.md section and table row). Non-forest precision/recall on the page are computed from the tp/fp/fn/tn counts: tn/(tn+fn), tn/(tn+fp).

tune_blocks.note: 100 m blocks of the north half of the 20 km window (about 20 x 10 km) on which T_db was chosen

glad_l_on_prior_clearing.path: ## Share of 2026 GLAD alerts on land already cleared before 2026, row 'GLAD-L | 2026 (all), whole window'

detector.path: ## Thresholds (HH rise threshold row and the paragraph under it); ## Supporting diagnostics (hansen_classes.py)
